# REST endpoint reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/docs/reference.ts. Do not edit; run `pnpm docs:reference`. -->

62 routes, generated from the server's route table. All take and return JSON unless noted, and need
`Authorization: Bearer rf_...` with the scope shown (`admin` implies every scope).

Lists are pages (D-102): `GET /v1/projects`, `GET /v1/jobs` and `GET /v1/assets` take `?limit=` (1 to 200,
default 50) and `?cursor=` and answer the newest page plus `nextCursor` (null on the last page); see
[REST API: lists and pages](/docs/api/rest-api#lists-and-pages). `GET /v1/audit` and the delivery log page the same way
with their own sizes.

## Outside /v1

| Route | Auth | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /healthz` | none | Liveness: the process answers |
| `GET /readyz` | none | Readiness: 200 when the server can take work (storage health included), else 503 |
| `GET /metrics` | optional bearer token | Prometheus metrics, only when `observability.metrics.exporter` is `prometheus` |
| `GET /.well-known/mcp.json` | none | MCP server card: endpoint, tools, resources, prompts |
| `POST /mcp` | Bearer key | The MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP) |
